title: Prediction with Foundation Models under Deployment Budgets
abstract: arXiv:2611.12466v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Foundation models can supply predictions for a downstream task that draw on knowledge from extensive pretraining, but they differ in task-specific accuracy and query cost. We develop a framework that improves prediction for the task under a budget on the average query cost per input, using training data to learn which models to query and how to combine their outputs with features available without querying. The first method queries the same models for every input; the second lets them vary across inputs and uses Q-learning to decide which model to query next and when to stop. For the first method, we show that several individually inaccurate outputs can jointly outperform the best single one. It attains the minimax rate when the regression function depends on the outputs only through models within the budget. translated_title: 部署预算约束下基于基础模型的预测
translated_abstract: 基础模型能够为下游任务提供预测，这些预测借鉴了大规模预训练所积累的知识，但不同基础模型在任务特定准确率和查询成本方面存在差异。我们开发了一个框架，在每条输入的平均查询成本预算约束下改进下游任务的预测，利用训练数据来学习应查询哪些模型，以及如何将模型输出与无需查询即可获得的特征相结合。第一种方法对每条输入查询相同的模型；第二种方法则允许不同输入查询不同的模型，并使用Q学习来决定下一个查询哪个模型以及何时停止查询。对于第一种方法，我们证明了多个单独并不准确的输出组合起来可以优于最佳的单个输出。当回归函数仅通过预算内的模型输出而依赖于这些输出时，该方法可以达到极小化极大率；否则，预算约束下的任何方法都可能被迫只能达到更慢的收敛率，而第一种方法恰好能达到该较慢的速率。对于第二种方法……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了在平均查询成本预算约束下提升基础模型预测性能的框架：固定查询模型的方法可达到极小化极大最优率，并证明多个单独欠佳的模型输出组合后可超越最佳单一模型；自适应方法则借助Q学习为不同输入动态选择查询模型并决定停止时机。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework for improving prediction with foundation models under an average query cost budget, where a fixed-query method attains the minimax rate (showing that several individually inaccurate outputs can jointly outperform the best single one), while an adaptive method uses Q-learning to decide which model to query next and when to stop for each input.
